name: Scan QR Code Now
description:
Scan QR codes fast and easy with our trusted QR code scanner for iPhone – download for FREE now!


Quickly scan QR codes and barcodes. Whether you're looking up a restaurant menu, leaving a review, or making your own QR codes, this app makes it super easy!

FEATURES:
- QR Code Reader & Barcode Scanner – Scan any code in seconds.
- Create & Share QR Codes – Make your own codes to share with friends or for business.
- Auto Scan – Just point your camera and it scans!
- Find Deals & Coupons – Scan to discover discounts.
- Safe Browsing – See where links go before clicking.
- Save & Share Scans – Export scans or share right away via messaging.


*SUBSCRIPTIONS

You can subscribe to Scan QR Code Now to get access to premium features, like unlimited scans, code creation, and more.

Try premium with a 3-day FREE trial, then just $6.99/week for unlimited scans and more!
